Silver, probably base. Coin. Probably a Radiate of Gallienus (253-268), Reece period 12. Obverse description: Bust right, probably radiate and with Roman nose. Obverse inscription: [---]VS AVG. Reverse description: Quadruped with long horns, perhaps ibex, left. Reverse inscription: [--] ?A AVG. In exergue: Three or four characters, resembling TIO.
